verdict.rationale: Svelte is a component framework built around declarative components (svelte-gh-1, svelte-docs-4). Components hold local reactive state as plain variables, with $state.raw, $derived and $effect on top (svelte-docs-5, svelte-docs-6, svelte-docs-7, svelte-docs-8), and styles scoped to each component reinforce encapsulation (svelte-docs-11). Context, stores and .svelte.js modules cover sharing state across composed parts (svelte-docs-12, svelte-comm-5), and a migrated 'huge/complex' app corroborates real-world composition (svelte-comm-8). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the composition mechanics (props, snippets/slots, nesting child components) and hands-on detail on how composition works in practice.
